mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by > 10% y-o-y, signaling a weakening housing market, and the unemployment rate is rising, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% y-o-y and UNRATE is rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 60, signaling a very strong manufacturing sector, and the unemployment rate is below 4%, signaling a tight labor market, it will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 60 and UNRATE < 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1%, signaling extremely accommodative monetary policy, and the CPI inflation rate is below 2%, signaling low inflation, it will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL inflation < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment, defined as a > 200k drop in PAYEMS over 1 month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines > 200k in 1 month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
